statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and unexplained collapse
There is concern for paroxysmal arrhythmias
The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has other cardiac arrhythmias (I49.9)
CPT 93247 is a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The service was ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances that may be missed on standard monitoring
The service was ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac activity
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial was based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
